# Switzerland

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### SIX Interbank Clearing AG

**Role:** Swiss market payment-standard publisher and infrastructure operator

**Reporting coverage:** Detailed national customer-reporting implementation guidelines

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08

- [SPS download center](https://www.six-group.com/de/products-services/banking-services/payment-standardization/downloads-faq/download-center.html) — specification; public-page
- [SPS 2025 Cash Management v2.2; effective 22 Nov 2025](https://www.six-group.com/dam/download/banking-services/standardization/sps/ig-cash-management-sps-2025-de.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [SPS 2026 Cash Management v2.3; effective 14 Nov 2026](https://www.six-group.com/dam/download/banking-services/standardization/sps/ig-cash-management-sps-2026-de.pdf) — specification; public-file

2026 document is published but future-effective as of verification. Current 2025 guideline and future 2026 guideline use ISO2019 v08. All rights reserved in guidelines; no redistribution licence inferred.
